title: Close the TutoredListenerSource channel gap and de-duplicate the two hand-maintained channelToKind switches

evidence.quote:
// The channel set mirrors the pull set in PullPipeline.pullForTutoredProfile
// (same collections, same order-field conventions) so listeners and the initial

why: TutoredListenerSource's own doc comment claims its channel set 'mirrors the pull set in PullPipeline.pullForTutoredProfile' -- but PullPipeline's tutored collection list includes `learning_order` (pull_pipeline.dart:276) while TutoredListenerSource.openChannels()'s returned map does not. This is not hypothetical: it is a confirmed, present gap -- a child's learning-order changes reach a tutored mirror only on the next explicit pull/refresh, never in real time, unlike every other Phase 2 collection. The proximate cause is structural: sync_orchestrator.dart and tutored_listener_supervisor.dart each hand-maintain their own channel-name-to-EntityKind switch with no shared source of truth, so adding a collection to one wiring point (the pull list) and forgetting another (the tutored channel map) compiles cleanly and fails silently -- exactly the class of 'real-time gap' bug this codebase's own Phase 2 comments describe having fixed before for the own-profile path.
recommendation: Add the missing 'learning_order' channel + EntityKind.learningOrder case to the tutored wiring; longer term, extract one shared channel -> (orderField, EntityKind) registry consumed by both firestore_listener_source.dart/sync_orchestrator.dart and tutored_listener_source.dart/tutored_listener_supervisor.dart so a new collection is wired in one place.
acceptance_criteria: Test asserting TutoredListenerSource.openChannels().keys and PullPipeline.pullForTutoredProfile's collection set are identical -- fails today on learning_order, passes after the fix.
